name: event_stream_retention
describes: The frame an SSE stream opens with, before any increment. It carries the coordinate the increments belong to, so a client whose snapshot cursor is behind `retained_from` learns that it must reload the snapshot instead of merging increments into an older context (0006 section 9).

source.note: EventStreamView; emitted by api/events.py as the first `event: retention` frame of the stream.
